description: Union Minister for Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, and Rural Development, Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan
body_lead: Union Minister for Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, and Rural Development, Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan will be on a visit to Rajasthan on February 17, during which he will launch the new digital companion ‘Bharat-VISTAAR’ in Jaipur for farmers across the country.
